title: TF Regression Code Along - Model Evaluation and Predictions

cues.en: (bright music)
cues.zh: （輕快音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome back everyone to Part 3 of our Keras Regression Code Along project.
cues.zh: 講師：各位，歡迎回到 Keras 迴歸實作專案的第三部分。

cues.en: So we just in the previous lecture, ended up training our model and fitting to that training set.
cues.zh: 上堂課我們已經訓練模型，讓它擬合訓練集。

cues.en: Now it's time to explore an evaluation on not just our test data, but also being able to predict the price of a new house given its features.
cues.zh: 現在要評估測試資料，也要根據新房屋的特徵，預測房價。

cues.en: Let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Okay, here we are in the notebook where we left off last time.
cues.zh: 回到上次停下來的筆記本。

cues.en: We just finished training for those 400 epochs.
cues.zh: 剛剛已完成 400 個 epoch 的訓練。

cues.en: What I'm going to do now is explore what my model history looks like now.
cues.zh: 現在要探索模型的訓練歷程。

cues.en: So recall, we can get a history of those losses by saying model.history.history and it returns back this dictionary.
cues.zh: 還記得，使用 model.history.history，就能取得損失歷程，傳回這個字典。

cues.en: However, because we passed in the validation data to what I can now do is when I convert this to a data frame,
cues.zh: 不過，因為我們還傳入驗證資料，所以轉成資料框時，

cues.en: I not just get my loss on my training set, but I also get this other variable called val_loss.
cues.zh: 除了訓練集損失，還會得到另一個叫 val_loss 的變數。

cues.en: And this is my loss on that test set that validation data.
cues.zh: 這就是測試集，也就是驗證資料上的損失。

cues.en: And now I can directly compare the loss on training versus the lost on test or validation in order to see if I'm overfitting to the training data on my model.
cues.zh: 現在可以直接比較訓練損失和測試或驗證損失，判斷模型是否過度擬合訓練資料。

cues.en: And the best way to do that is by simply plotting these.
cues.zh: 最好的做法，就是直接把它們畫出來。

cues.en: So I will say losses is equal to pd.DataFrame and then I can say losses.plot.
cues.zh: 讓 losses 等於 pd.DataFrame 的結果，再呼叫 losses.plot。

cues.en: And I can directly compare the plot behavior of my blue training loss versus my orange validation loss.
cues.zh: 就能直接比較藍色訓練損失和橘色驗證損失的曲線。

cues.en: And this is exactly the kind of signal we want where there's decrease in both the training loss and the validation loss.
cues.zh: 這正是想看到的情況：訓練損失和驗證損失都下降。

cues.en: And then there is no increase so far in the validation set.
cues.zh: 而且目前驗證損失並沒有增加。

cues.en: And actually what that means is technically, we could have continued training.
cues.zh: 這實際上表示，技術上還可以繼續訓練。

cues.en: Now you'll notice that towards the tail end, we're actually not improving that much.
cues.zh: 不過你會注意到，在尾端進步已經不大。

cues.en: So after 400 epochs, it looks like we're kind of hovering around this particular loss value and the decreasing is happening much slower.
cues.zh: 400 個 epoch 後，看起來損失大致在這個值附近徘徊，下降速度慢了很多。

cues.en: But because the validation loss is also going down, that's an indicator that we could continue training without overfitting to our training data.
cues.zh: 但因為驗證損失也持續下降，表示可以繼續訓練，而不會過度擬合訓練資料。

cues.en: If you saw this orange line begin to spike after some of these epochs, so it started to go up and up and up that means you're overfitting to the training data because now you have a much larger loss
cues.zh: 如果橘線在某些 epoch 之後開始飆升、不斷往上，表示對訓練資料過度擬合了，因為現在，

cues.en: on your validation data.
cues.zh: 驗證資料的損失大幅增加。

cues.en: And later on in the lectures we'll see an example of that which will allow us to then actually implement what's known as early stopping.
cues.zh: 後面的課程會看到這種例子，屆時就能實作所謂的提前停止。

cues.en: In this case, this is pretty much the perfect behavior you wanna see.
cues.zh: 在這個案例，曲線基本上是理想的表現。

cues.en: You wanna see training loss and validation loss go down and then continue down together.
cues.zh: 我們希望訓練損失和驗證損失一起下降，並持續共同下降。

cues.en: So there's no overfitting that we can see occurring here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡看不出有過度擬合。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's do some evaluation on our test data.
cues.zh: 好，現在來評估測試資料。

cues.en: So what we can do is a variety of methods on this.
cues.zh: 可以使用各種方法。

cues.en: We can say from sklearn.metrics import, and we can import things like the mean_squared_error,
cues.zh: 從 sklearn.metrics 匯入 mean_squared_error，

cues.en: the mean_absolute_error.
cues.zh: 以及 mean_absolute_error。

cues.en: And we can also, even if we want, get an explained variance score.
cues.zh: 如果想要，也能取得 explained_variance_score。

cues.en: So what we do here is we grab our predictions
cues.zh: 先取得預測值，

cues.en: by saying model.predict and we're gonna predict on the test set.
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.predict，對測試集預測。

cues.en: So we run that and now recall we have our list of predictions.
cues.zh: 執行後，就有預測值清單。

cues.en: And what we're going to do is simply compare these to what we know are the correct values.
cues.zh: 接著把它們和已知的正確值比較。

cues.en: So we can call mean_squared_error or mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 可以呼叫 mean_squared_error 或 mean_absolute_error。

cues.en: We can do both.
cues.zh: 兩者都可以算。

cues.en: And what we do is we first pass in y true.
cues.zh: 首先傳入 y_true。

cues.en: So recall that is y test and then we compare that to our predictions.
cues.zh: 還記得，就是 y_test，再和預測值比較。

cues.en: So our total mean squared error here is this value.
cues.zh: 所以這裡整體均方誤差是這個值。

cues.en: This is a very large value, which kind of makes sense because we're dealing with the prices of houses.
cues.zh: 數值非常大，這很合理，因為我們處理的是房屋價格。

cues.en: So we're squaring those.
cues.zh: 還要將它們平方。

cues.en: So it should be a large value.
cues.zh: 所以數值應該很大。

cues.en: This is really hard to interpret.
cues.zh: 這很難解讀。

cues.en: So what we can do is either get the root mean squared error by taking the square root of this either by running NPU or NP square root.
cues.zh: 因此可以對它開平方根，得到均方根誤差，使用 NumPy 的方式或 np.sqrt 都行。

cues.en: This is our square root error or root mean squared error.
cues.zh: 這就是平方根誤差，也就是均方根誤差。

cues.en: Or what we can do is also get mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 另一個做法是取得平均絕對誤差。

cues.en: So mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 使用 mean_absolute_error。

cues.en: It's really easy to interpret because it's essentially just what is your average absolute error across all your predictions.
cues.zh: 它很容易解讀，基本上就是所有預測的平均絕對誤差。

cues.en: So we can say y test versus predictions and it looks like our mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 比較 y_test 和 predictions，就能看到平均絕對誤差。

cues.en: So on average we're off by about $100,000.
cues.zh: 平均而言，我們大約相差 10 萬美元。

cues.en: Now is that good or is that bad?
cues.zh: 這算好還是不好？

cues.en: Again, we have to take into account the actual data frame itself.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，必須考慮實際資料框的情況。

cues.en: So we have to take into account our price column off the original data frame call, describe on it and see what kind of values we're actually dealing with.
cues.zh: 查看原始資料框的 price 欄，呼叫 describe，了解實際處理的數值。

cues.en: So recall that the mean, it looks like it's 5.4 times 10 to the five.
cues.zh: 還記得，平均值看起來是 5.4 乘以 10 的 5 次方。

cues.en: So if we actually grab this and put it in here as a number, it'll report back that the average price of the house is around $540,000.
cues.zh: 把它作為數字放在這裡，就能看到房屋平均價格約 54 萬美元。

cues.en: In our case, our mean absolute error is about $100,000.
cues.zh: 而我們的平均絕對誤差約 10 萬美元。

cues.en: So that's not really that great.
cues.zh: 所以其實沒有非常好。

cues.en: We're off by around 20%, so not great, not horrible either.
cues.zh: 大約差了 20%，不算很好，但也不算糟。

cues.en: What we can also do is use an explained variance score to try to get a deeper understanding of our evaluation metrics here.
cues.zh: 我們也能使用解釋變異分數，更深入理解這裡的評估指標。

cues.en: So I can use explain variance score and if you do shift tab here, it'll essentially explain what's actually happening here.
cues.zh: 使用 explained_variance_score，按 Shift+Tab，就能大致看到它在做什麼。

cues.en: So the best possible score is 1.0, and what this does, it tells you how much variance is being explained by your actual model.
cues.zh: 最佳分數是 1.0，它告訴你模型實際解釋了多少變異。

cues.en: And you take a look at the online documentation for further examples of how this actually works and how it actually is calculated.
cues.zh: 可以查看線上文件，進一步了解範例、運作與計算方式。

cues.en: But what we can do here is same as before, pass in our Y test values versus our predictions and we're getting the explained variance score of somewhere around 0.8.
cues.zh: 和先前一樣，傳入 y_test 與預測值，得到約 0.8 的解釋變異分數。

cues.en: So in this case, 0.79.
So that's just merely, okay.
cues.zh: 所以只能說還可以。

cues.en: Again, it really depends on the context.
cues.zh: 同樣要視情境而定。

cues.en: Do we have a previous model that actually performs better than this?
cues.zh: 我們是否有表現更好的既有模型？

cues.en: We also noticed that technically we could still keep training and keep lowering this loss.
cues.zh: 也注意到，技術上仍能持續訓練，讓損失繼續下降。

cues.en: So maybe it's worth it to try to keep training on the training data since we technically haven't actually reached overfitting on it quite yet due to our analysis here.
cues.zh: 因為從這裡的分析來看，還沒有發生過度擬合，也許值得繼續用訓練資料訓練。

cues.en: What we can also compare is our predictions and we can plot them out against a perfect fit.
cues.zh: 還能把預測值畫出來，和完美擬合的情況比較。

cues.en: So recall that previously what we did, we did a scatterplot of Y test versus our predictions
cues.zh: 還記得，之前把 y_test 和預測值畫成散佈圖，

cues.en: and we can see the way they fit here.
cues.zh: 這裡就能看到它們的符合程度。

cues.en: And what I can do is make this a little larger.
cues.zh: 我可以把圖放大。

cues.en: So I can say plt.figure figsize is equal to let's say 12 by 6 in order to fit everything nicely.
cues.zh: 使用 plt.figure，把 figsize 設成例如 12 乘 6，讓所有內容合適地顯示。

cues.en: Now, in a perfect world, this would be a straight line and we can compare by saying plt.plot and I'm just going to plot y_test against y_test.
cues.zh: 在理想情況下，點會在一直線上；可以用 plt.plot，把 y_test 對 y_test 作圖來比較。

cues.en: And I'll just say, this is a red line by saying r.
cues.zh: 再用 r 把線設成紅色。

cues.en: And now this red line represents the best or the basically the perfect prediction line.
cues.zh: 這條紅線代表最佳，也就是完美預測線。

cues.en: You'll notice that we're basically being punished here by these outliers.
cues.zh: 會注意到，這裡的離群值讓我們受到懲罰。

cues.en: So these really expensive houses we're actually not good at predicting the price but we're pretty good at predicting the prices of houses between zero and $2 million.
cues.zh: 我們不擅長預測這些非常昂貴的房子，但對零到 200 萬美元之間的房價，預測得相當不錯。

cues.en: This is actually not so bad.
cues.zh: 這其實不算差。

cues.en: There's clearly a good fit here between our tests and our predictions.
cues.zh: 測試值和預測值在這裡明顯有不錯的吻合。

cues.en: And that's essentially what explain variance score is trying to report back to you in the form of a single number.
cues.zh: explained_variance_score 就是試著把這點濃縮成一個數字告訴你。

cues.en: What may be worth it is to retrain our model just on that bottom 99% of houses.
cues.zh: 或許值得只用價格最低的 99% 房屋重新訓練模型。

cues.en: And so if we come up to a situation where our maybe sale price is over $3 million, we'll just say, "Sorry our model's not good enough for this,"
cues.zh: 如果遇到可能售價超過 300 萬美元的房子，就說：「抱歉，模型不足以處理這個情況。」

cues.en: and we'll only refit to that bottom 99%.
cues.zh: 只對價格最低的 99% 重新擬合。

cues.en: Again, it really depends on the context and what questions you're trying to answer and what problems you're trying to solve.
cues.zh: 同樣取決於情境，以及你想回答什麼問題、解決什麼問題。

cues.en: Okay, so finally let's show you how you would use your model to predict on a brand new house.
cues.zh: 好，最後示範如何用模型預測一棟全新的房子。

cues.en: So let's take a look at our original data frame.
cues.zh: 看一下原始資料框。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and just pick the very first house here.
cues.zh: 直接選取第一棟房子。

cues.en: So let's say df.
cues.zh: 使用 df。

cues.en: And what we'll do is we're gonna drop the price of this house.
cues.zh: 我們會刪除這棟房子的 price。

cues.en: So say drop the price along, access is equal to 1 and then just grab the very first house here.
cues.zh: 沿 axis=1 刪除 price，再取得第一棟房子。

cues.en: So what this is, these are only the features of a new house on market.
cues.zh: 這些就只包含一棟新上市房屋的特徵。

cues.en: So let's say a new house is coming onto the market and you want to sell it on October, 2014.
cues.zh: 假設一棟新房子即將上市，想在 2014 年十月售出。

cues.en: And you know these various features of the house, you know how many bedrooms it has, you know how many bathrooms it has, et cetera.
cues.zh: 你知道各種房屋特徵，例如有幾間臥室、幾間浴室等。

cues.en: You know its condition whether or not it's waterfront, et cetera.
cues.zh: 知道屋況，以及是否臨水等資訊。

cues.en: So we have all these features for a new house coming onto the market.
cues.zh: 所以有了新上市房屋的所有特徵。

cues.en: Now the next step is to actually scale this single house data.
cues.zh: 下一步是縮放這棟房屋的資料。

cues.en: Recall that our model is trained on scaled versions of the features which means we can't actually pass in these features raw.
cues.zh: 還記得，模型是用縮放後的特徵訓練，所以不能直接傳入原始特徵。

cues.en: Instead, what we need to do is say single_house, grab those values.
cues.zh: 而是要取得 single_house 的 values。

cues.en: So now it's a NumPy array, but the shape is actually off.
cues.zh: 現在成為 NumPy 陣列，但形狀還不對。

cues.en: Notice there's only one set of braces or brackets there.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡只有一層括號，也就是中括號。

cues.en: I need to reshape this to be negative 1 by 19.
cues.zh: 必須把形狀改成負 1 乘 19。

cues.en: And you'll notice now that essentially adds that extra set of brackets there, which is the shape expected.
cues.zh: 這樣基本上就多加了一層中括號，符合預期形狀。

cues.en: Negative 1 just basically means keep those old dimensions along that axis.
cues.zh: 負 1 基本上表示沿著該軸保留原有維度。

cues.en: So now that I have it in the correct shape, I should be able to say, scaler.transform on this.
cues.zh: 現在形狀正確，就能對它呼叫 scaler.transform。

cues.en: And now I have the scaled versions of everything.
cues.zh: 這樣全部特徵都有了縮放後的版本。

cues.en: And now we'll reset this to be our single house.
cues.zh: 再重新指定成 single_house。

cues.en: So now that I have my single house, I'll say model.predict on my single house, run this and now I have the predicted price that this will sell at.
cues.zh: 現在對 single_house 呼叫 model.predict，執行後就得到預測售價。

cues.en: And if I take a look at df.head, the very first item there, just show one, the true price it sold at was $221,000
cues.zh: 查看 df.head，顯示第一筆資料，也就是只顯示一列，實際售價是 221,000 美元，

cues.en: and I'm predicting it will sell at $288,000.
cues.zh: 而我預測會賣到 288,000 美元。

cues.en: So it looks like we are kind of overshooting here.
cues.zh: 所以看起來高估了一些。

cues.en: And again, that may be an issue when we're trying to fit to these extreme values.
cues.zh: 這也可能和嘗試擬合極端值有關。

cues.en: So an interesting next step to actually undertake would be to retrain your model by dropping out maybe the top 1 or 2% of values and see
cues.zh: 一個值得做的下一步，是刪除最高的 1% 或 2% 數值，重新訓練模型，看看，

cues.en: if that can reduce your mean squared error on your data set.
cues.zh: 是否能降低資料集上的均方誤差。

cues.en: But for right now, I would say we're pretty much done with this project.
cues.zh: 不過現在，這個專案差不多完成了。

cues.en: We've been able to do a little bit of feature engineering, do a little bit of exploratory data analysis, create and train a model and then get back a relatively reasonable model
cues.zh: 我們做了一些特徵工程、探索式資料分析，建立並訓練模型，最後得到相對合理的模型，

cues.en: in order to predict the prices of houses.
cues.zh: 用來預測房價。

cues.en: It's not like we're predicting $2 billion on a $200,000 house.
cues.zh: 並沒有把一棟 20 萬美元的房子預測成 20 億美元。

cues.en: Instead we're relatively in the range of what a house could sell at, and it looks like we're more or less explaining quite a bit of variance up to 80% of the variance in the pricing.
cues.zh: 而是大致落在可能成交的範圍內，而且看起來解釋了相當多的價格變異，最多約 80%。

cues.en: Okay, so that's it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 好，這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: Coming up next, we're gonna begin to dive deeper into a lot of these topics based on things like batch sizes and early stopping in our model.
cues.zh: 接下來會更深入探討許多主題，例如模型中的批次大小和提前停止。

cues.en: And we'll do that by taking a look at classification tasks through TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 我們會透過 TensorFlow 的分類任務來介紹。

cues.en: I'll see you at the next lecture.
cues.zh: 下堂課見。
